config.description: Config C6: LoRI (frozen A, sparse B gradient mask) with PLANNED (human-fixed) curriculum. This is the control needed to measure LoRI's own Curriculum Transfer Gap (CTG) by comparing C6 (planned) vs C5 (self-generated). Without this run, the claim 'LoRI eliminates the CTG' is untestable.
